steps.npc: Hello.
My name is Hari.

steps.player: And what are you doing here Hari?

steps.npc: Like most people who come to Edgeville, I am here to seek adventure in the Wilderness.
I found a secret underground river that will take me quite a long way north.

steps.player: Underground river? Where does it come out?

steps.npc: It comes out in a pond located deep in the Wilderness.
I had to find a very special type of canoe to get me up the river though, would you like to know more?

steps.player: Could you teach me about canoes?

steps.npc: Well, you don't look like you have the skill to make a canoe.
You need to have at least level 12 woodcutting.
Once you are able to make a canoe it makes travel along the river much quicker!
It's really quite simple. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
When you have done that you can shape the log further with your axe to make a canoe.
I can sense you're still a novice woodcutter, you will only be able to make a log canoe at present.
A log will take you one stop along the river. But you won't be able to travel into the Wilderness on it.
You are an average woodcutter. You should be able to make a Dugout canoe quite easily. It will take you 2 stops along the river.

steps.player: Can I take a dugout canoe to reach the Wilderness?

steps.npc: You would never make it there alive.
You seem to be an accomplished woodcutter. You will easily be able to make a Stable Dugout
They are reliable enough to get you anywhere on this river, except to the Wilderness of course.
Only a Waka can take you there.
Come and ask me when you have improved your skills as a woodcutter.
Your skills rival mine friend. You will certainly be able to build a Waka.
A Waka is an invention of my people, it's an incredible strong and fast canoe and will carry you safely to any destination on the river.
Yes, you can take a waka north through the underground portion of this river.
It will bring you out at a pond in the heart of the Wilderness. Be careful up there, many have lost more than their lives in that dark and twisted place.

options.text: Can you teach me about Canoeing?

steps.player: Could you teach me about canoes?
